flow.name: axn-term - real claude resume record carries the conversation name
flow.description: Launches real claude in an axn-term session, names the conversation with /rename, exits with /exit and checks the saved resume record (last + history) carries the name although claude clears its terminal title on exit. No model call is made.

step.description: Create a temp state dir (real claude, no fake binary)
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Run real claude, /rename the conversation, wait for the plugin to see the name

assert.description: The name was seen while claude ran

step.description: /exit claude and wait for the resume record

assert.description: claude ended and the record exists

step.description: The resume record and history carry the name
The name survives in the saved state
